official_title.value: A Phase 3 Clinical Trial to Confirm Efficacy and Evaluate Safety of Twice-daily Delgocitinib Cream 20 mg/g Compared With Cream Vehicle for a 16-week Treatment Period in Adult Subjects With Moderate to Severe Chronic Hand Eczema (DELTA 2)

mechanism_of_action.source_excerpt: openFDA drug/label mechanism_of_action (FDA-approved label, section 12.1) -- v1 extracted text: 12.1 Mechanism of Action Delgocitinib, a Janus kinase (JAK) inhibitor, inhibits the activity of JAK1, JAK2, JAK3, and tyrosine kinase 2 (TYK2). JAK signaling involves recruitment of signal transducers and activators of transcription (STATs) to cytokine receptors, and activation and subsequent localization of STATs to the nucleus, leading to the expression of cytokine-responsive genes to induce specific biological responses in target cells. The exact mechanism of action of delgocitinib in the treatment of moderate to severe CHE is currently not known.

However, emollients should preferably not be used on the affected areas within 2 hours before and after application of IMP... multiplicity_control.source_excerpt: A closed testing procedure with hierarchical tests, alpha splitting and alpha recycling will be used to control the overall type I error at a nominal one-sided 2.5% level. The statistical testing strategy is built on the principle that the IGA-CHE TS superiority at Week 16 will have to be established before testing for additional benefits (key secondary endpoints)... Panel 22: Graphical display of closed testing procedure for primary and key secondary endpoints [alpha=2.5% (one-sided), IGA-CHE TS at Week 16 -> Primary endpoint, branching 4/5 alpha and 1/5 alpha to two tiers of key secondary endpoints].

study_schedule.source_excerpt: Trial design: ...The trial consists of a screening period, a treatment period, and a follow-up period. Screening period: ...minimum duration of 1 week and a maximum duration of 4 weeks... can be extended up to 31 days. Treatment period: ...randomised 2:1... twice daily for 16 weeks... return to the trial site for the visits scheduled at Weeks 1, 2, 4, 8, 12, and 16. Follow-up period: ...follow-up visit (performed via phone...) approximately 2 weeks after the last IMP application... Eligible subjects who complete the treatment period... will be invited to participate in an open-label LTE trial (LP0133-1403).

value.rationale: IGA-CHE TS at Week 16 without IEs (initiation of rescue treatment or permanent discontinuation of IMP) is the primary estimand; subjects who experience these intercurrent events are treated as non-responders in the composite strategy.

rescue_therapy.source_excerpt: 9.5 Rescue treatment: If medically necessary (i.e. to control intolerable CHE symptoms), rescue treatment for CHE may be prescribed to trial subjects at the discretion of the investigator... If rescue treatment is initiated, the subject must stop treatment with IMP immediately and will not be allowed to restart treatment with IMP. Subjects who discontinue IMP will be asked to attend an early termination visit, a follow-up visit... and also the primary endpoint visit at Week 16. ... (Section 5.3): the primary estimand... is selected to be IGA-CHE TS... at Week 16 without IEs (initiation of rescue treatment or permanent discontinuation of IMP)... subjects who experience IEs are considered non-responders to treatment.
